title: Universal Access Is Essential for 10% and Supportive for 40% of Kingdom's Population
summary: A Saudi news report argues that universal accessibility projects are critical for people with disabilities and significantly beneficial for a broader segment of the population, including the elderly.
body:
A Saudi news report argues that universal accessibility projects are critical for people with disabilities and significantly beneficial for a broader segment of the population, including the elderly.
